newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Dialog seeks more oil, gas investments.
newsitem.headline: Dialog seeks more oil, gas investments.

text.p: Dialog Group Bhd said it is seeking more investment opportunities in the Malaysian downstream oil, gas, petrochemical and chemical industries "which are expected to experience phenomenal growth".

The engineering construction firm made the comments in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on Thursday in answer to a query about unusual stock market action. At midday Friday, its stock rose 3.75 to 41.75 ringgit.

It noted that it had previously announced an agreement with Malaysian Capital Ventures Sdn Bhd (MCV) which established the framework for jointly seeking investment opportunities in downstream oil, gas, petrochemical and chemical industries.

"Needless to say, DGB and MCV are still actively pursuing several other business opportunities, and as for DGB, it represents a continuous effort of adding value to the company for the benefit of its shareholders in the medium to long term," the statement said.

Dialog has also announced an agreement to look into the feasibility of building, owning and operating an independent bulk liquid tank and terminalling operations in the east coast state of Terengganu and the central Pahang state.

With these agreements and "the favourable financial results" announced by the company on August 7, coupled with investor expectations Dialog will continue to add value to its existing operations, "market sentiments on the company should be highly positive", the statement said.
